bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) echo VIDEO_REPO_MISMATCH; exit 61;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
sha="361267cb5e636d4fcc70655c63dada5672a98916"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || { echo VIDEO_FRESH_HEAD_CHANGED; exit 62; }
stage="$root/.worktrees/video-stars-361267cb"
if test -d "$stage"; then
 test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 63
 test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 64
else
 mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
 git worktree add --detach "$stage" "$sha"
fi
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo VIDEO_POLLER_COUNT_CHANGED; exit 65; }
id="${ids[0]}"
tag="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$id")"
printf 'LIVE_IMAGE_TAG=%s\n' "$tag"
printf 'LIVE_IMAGE_ID=%s\n' "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$id")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$id")"
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$id")"
case "$files" in *,*) echo MULTI_COMPOSE; exit 66;; *compose.videobot.poll.yaml) ;; *) echo UNKNOWN_COMPOSE; exit 67;; esac
test -f "$files" || exit 68
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$files" config --quiet
docker image inspect create-videobot:video-ui-be4f34d >/dev/null
echo VIDEO_STARS_DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT=PASS
